name: JPN Burst
summary: JPN BURST lets you drill through the Japanese kana systems: Hiragana and Katakana. See, type, and repeat until the characters are built into your muscle memory so you can efficiently study the Japanese language.

name: JPDE: Sonata of Fire
summary: A Fan Visual Novel based on the RWBY web series

name: JPEG
summary: A short psychological walk sim from a first-person perspective. Day after day, you perform routine tasks in the same apartment, following on-screen prompts. But the familiar walls begin to change — the protagonist is going mad, and so are you. Will you make it to the day the screen fades to black?
